title.narrative: Inclusive Democratic Participation: Enhancing Education, Engagement, and Oversigh

description.narrative:
The Arab Center for the Development of the Rule of Law and Integrity (ACRLI), in partnership

with the European Center for Electoral Support (ECES), will develop strategies to drive legal reforms, enhance democratic oversight tools, and build CSO capacity in leadership and conflict management for electoral stakeholders. The project will also raise awareness of democratic values and advocate for the political inclusion of women, youth, and people with disabilities. Sub-grantees will collaborate with ACRLI to implement nationwide awareness campaigns, promoting voter engagement and participation. The project¿s objectives are:

Objective 1: Improve the transparency, fairness, and integrity of Lebanon¿s electoral process through legal reforms and stronger oversight mechanisms.

Objective 2: Strengthen the capacity of electoral stakeholders to support and sustain democratic principles and practices.

Objective 3: Foster active and inclusive participation by increasing voter engagement through targeted campaigns and educational programs.

The reason is that we will slowly reduce our support for legal aid interventions in 2025. As the project tries to implement sustainable structures in the legal aid sector it will reduce its amount of funding in 2025 substantially to test how sustainable the provision of legal aid in Zambia is. Therefore the numbers for 2025 wil be a lot lower then for the rest of the years. Thus we only report on an accumulative target.
